title: These 3 Maryland Airbnbs Have Hot Tubs and Unreal Views - NewsBreak
text:
By Melanie Johnson ,
6 hours ago
When it comes to luxury vacations in Maryland, perhaps the first destinations that come to mind are Ocean City and St. Michaels. But luxury doesn’t have to be restricted just to the Eastern Shores. In fact, I can think of Airbnbs in Maryland boasting resort-style amenities, including indoor pools, lazy rivers, and water views that rival those of the islands. If you’re searching for a place to relax in style, here are my top picks for the best water feature Airbnbs in Mayland. These are the “guest favorite” rentals where you can forget about the outside world… even if only for a few days.
1. Mountain Escape with Indoor Jungle-Style Pool – McHenry, Maryland Photo courtesy of Airbnb Tucked away in the Allegheny Mountains along Deep Creek Lake, and just a few minutes from Wisp Ski Resort, is Sweet Dreams . Dubbed by past guests as one of the best Airbnbs in Maryland , the luxurious home features amenities for both indoor and outdoor fun, so you can expect to be entertained all year long. When swimming in the indoor pool, featuring a gushing waterfall, cave-like rockwork, and tropical vines, you’ll feel like you’re in the jungles of Thailand. The poolside bar enhances the vibe, where you can sip a tropical cocktail as you fully enjoy the scenery. In the winter months, this tranquil pool, along with the indoor basketball court, movie theater, pool table, game room, and the fireplace, is perfect for cozy nights when it’s too cold to play outdoors.
As the temperature rises, step outside to luxuriate in the private outdoor pool or unwind while soaking in the hot tub. When you’re not basking in the views of the tranquil lake, challenge your friends/family to a friendly game of volleyball. Sweet Dreams invites you to “ make your dream getaway a reality ,” and if you’re fantasizing about a vacation destination at one of the most luxurious Airbnbs with pools in Maryland, you’ve found it.
2. A Luxury Retreat with Its Own Indoor Lazy River – Swanton, Maryland Photo courtesy of Airbnb When you need a lazy day on the water, nothing can compete with a private, indoor lazy river with floating tubes. Yes, you heard that right! Lazy Creek is the only Airbnb in the Deep Creek Lake area with this resort-style perk, creating an immersive water experience that’s sure to impress you and your guests, especially the little ones. Adding to the fun, there’s an indoor pool just steps from the lazy river, so it’s like having your own personal waterpark at your doorstep.
For a large group of 16 guests, this eight-bedroom home has enough room for everyone to spread out and feel comfy. The home theater, game room, pool table, hot tub, and access to the lake and nearby hiking trails will keep you entertained and active while you stay. Since Deep Creek Lake State Park is about a 15-minute drive away, you can bring your own boat or rent one to enjoy more lazy days on the water, fishing, or simply watching the sunset over the lake. Or extend your outdoor experience chasing the best waterfalls in Maryland at Swallow Falls State Park. If you’re celebrating a special occasion or just need a place to relax, bring the entire family (including the pup) to what we think is one of the must-visit luxury Airbnbs in Maryland for summer.
3. A Remote Hideaway with Unbelievable Bay Views – Cambridge, Maryland Photo courtesy of Airbnb It’s not every day that you get to wake up to wide-open views of the Choptank River or have a private beach to yourself. You can find that and more at Blue Water Farm , a waterfront Airbnb in Maryland about an hour south of Annapolis. This sprawling estate is tucked away on a secluded 143-acre farm and includes a separate guest house (party house) with a bar, pool room, and a fireplace. With that much space, you’ll be fully surrounded by nature’s peace as you wander the remote trails or stroll along the water’s edge.
Imagine spending your days on the deck of the saltwater pool overlooking the river, watching the crabbing boats drift by. After soaking up the sun, walk to your private dock to fish or pull in Maryland blue crabs, while marveling at the water views. Kayaks are available for morning paddles on the waterway, where you can glimpse herons, ospreys, or bald eagles flying above. At the end of your day, gather by a bonfire to watch the sunset over the Bay, then head indoors to the party house to close the night with a friendly game of pool or wind down with a glass of wine by the fireplace. I can see why this Airbnb has a five-star rating. It has everything you would expect from a luxury estate once owned by the prestigious Du Pont family.
Are these Airbnbs Worth Booking? Photo courtesy of Airbnb Some of my favorite Airbnbs have been surrounded by water, but these rentals go beyond the typical waterfront retreats. Between the indoor jungle-style pool, lazy river, and private beach with Bay views, it’s easy to see why these Airbnbs get booked over and over again. Whether you need a spot for a girls’ trip, family retreat, or for a special occasion, you really can’t go wrong with a weekend at one of these resort-style Airbnbs in Maryland. Each rental offers a truly relaxing experience, and when you leave, chances are, you won’t feel like you’ll need a vacation after your vacation (if you know, you know).
